heading: Citizenship of officers of vessels
lead: The officers of vessels of the United States shall in all cases by citizens of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 601934 U.S.C. 211.R.S. 1428.
